decision: Initialize standalone hivemind-substrate repository from opencode-session-archive, context-prune, compaction-continuity, and the three Context Substrate architecture dossiers.
rationale: Unifies The Spine, The Honeycomb, and Viewports in one isolated package wired into the workspace.

decision: Ingest opencode.db kv child bindings, shadow snapshot git tree blobs, and external tool-output/shell spill files into .session-archive/blobs/ and index.sqlite, keying delegation by (parent_session_id, call_id).
rationale: Prevents multi-turn child continuations from overwriting Turn 1, recovers uncommitted intermediate drafts before shadow git gc, captures 700KB+ external tool spills before host GC, and separates host_idle_outcome from semantic_status and verified_status.

decision: Use Bun.Transpiler.scan() + Depth-2 pure-TS skeletonizer (+4.2 KB), pure-TS Float64Array PageRank (+3.1 KB), and git log co-change mining (+2.4 KB) instead of bundling typescript@5.9.3 (+8.80 MB) or native/WASM addons.
rationale: Preserves the single-file dist/*.ts copy-install invariant, achieves 22.2ms warm parse across 51 files (90.5% token compression), indexes 28 inner closure helpers inside createNativeDelegationDriver, computes PageRank in 0.79ms, and surfaces non-static co-change couplings (e.g. devin-executable <-> harness-antigravity 66.7%).

decision: Expose Proactive Lifecycle Hooks (in-memory step-watermark context hook, SQLite-backed compaction hook, idle/compacted background sync) plus two deep tools (substrate.viewport and substrate.valve).
rationale: Eliminates manual persist choreography, enables intra-turn pruning during 45-step single-prompt runs via assistant step watermarks + FactBreadcrumbs + Do-Not-Reread WorkingMemoryManifest, and retires .opencode/compaction-history/*.jsonl hot-reload hazards.

decision: Approve WF-SUB-08 Q1..Q3 (unified substrate.valve + substrate.viewport surface with archive.persist and ctx.context-prune compatibility aliases, hybrid K=8 explicit / K=12 at 65% window valve, and exported buildImplementorViewportBrief helper); lock ADR-001..003 to accepted; synthesize and independently review E1.1..E1.3 SPEC.md (REQ-SUB-01..18) and DEEP-MODULE-DESIGN.md.
rationale: Preserves backwards compatibility with existing prompt habits while unifying all three prototypes under a < 2 ms in-memory context hook budget and falsifiable phase requirements.

decision: Resolve UAT remediation decisions A1..A4: (A1) expose native OpenTUI Solid ./tui surface (@opencode/plugin/tui + @opentui/solid + @opencode/theme/tui + SubstrateRpc) and zero-config CLI (bun run substrate <action>); (A2) keep only 4 tools (substrate.valve, substrate.viewport, archive.persist, ctx.context-prune) and drop redundant root substrate/viewport aliases; (A3) unify FileReadCapture slice-normalized SHA-256 domain across normalize/valve/reconcileProvenanceStaleness with 3-state coverage (FRESH, SLICE Lstart-Lend of total, STALE) and attach JIT Tier-2 AstSkeleton + Tier-4 CoChangeCoupling footer via ctx.tool.hook("execute.after") on truncated reads; (A4) centralize single-owner DDL in src/archive/index-db.ts and purge all WF-SUB prototype scaffolding.
rationale: Eliminates the raw-tool-output vs raw-disk hash mismatch (12/12 empirical match), fixes manual substrate.valve 0-of-0 no-op via ctx.session.context({ sessionID }) + sqliteSource fallback, removes fabricated S2 msg[124..125] text, and gives both agents and humans a truthful progressive-disclosure interface.
